prompt: Make this paragraph easier for a general audience to understand: 'The room booking procedure comprises submission of an intended usage interval, subsequent availability verification, and issuance of an acknowledgement. An acknowledgement of receipt does not constitute approval of the requested interval.' Aim for about 80 words.
text: To book a room, first submit the dates and times you would like to use it. The booking team will then check whether the room is available. After receiving your request, they will send you a confirmation that it was received. Please note that this confirmation only means your request is being processed—it does not mean your booking has been approved. You should wait for a separate message confirming that the room is reserved for you.
